about: Eval set for the copilot's understanding. The same file scores the LLM (server/eval_phrasings.py, real Ollama) and the app's rule parser (app/src/copilot/phrasings.test.ts). targets: the acceptable target_id values (null = none named / here). clarify: the place is ambiguous and the copilot must ask which one. Place names are the Curiosity boxwork stops in data/processed/gale/science_targets.json.

targets.name: Valle de la Luna (hollow drill site)
